annotations.betterLine: Fetch a basic Swamp (saving 2 life), cast Emperor of Bones turn 2 with BB, then play Watery Grave from hand turn 3 for Psychic Frog. Against a Leyline Axe deck, every point of life matters.

annotations.description: The player should have played Arid Mesa from hand as their land for the turn before casting Stoneforge Mystic. Playing the land first costs nothing and preserves options (e.g., later sacrificing Sunbaked Canyon to draw a card if mana is available from Arid Mesa instead).
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Stoneforge Mystic without first making a land drop with Arid Mesa from hand.
annotations.betterLine: Play Arid Mesa first (making the land drop), then cast Stoneforge Mystic using Sacred Foundry and Sunbaked Canyon (or Arid Mesa fetching a white source).

annotations.description: Casting Sign in Blood before playing Polluted Delta from hand. Should play the land first to preserve options after seeing the two drawn cards - they might draw something they want to deploy this turn with the extra mana from the fetch land.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Sign in Blood before making land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play Polluted Delta first (potentially crack it for a Swamp/Island), then cast Sign in Blood with the drawn cards informing further decisions. Also worth considering Emperor of Bones as an alternative play to develop board presence against the opponent's equipment threats.

annotations.description: Stoneforge Mystic's activated ability costs {1}{W} and tap. The player has Sacred Foundry (W/R) and Sunbaked Canyon (W/R) untapped, plus Paradise Mantle is on the battlefield (but not equipped to anything that can tap). Actually, looking more carefully: Sacred Foundry can produce W, Sunbaked Canyon can produce W or R (pay 1 life), and Urza's Saga on chapter II can produce C. So the player has access to {C}{W}{W/R} = 3 mana. Stoneforge Mystic costs {1}{W} to activate, which is easily payable. The player could activate Stoneforge Mystic to put Colossus Hammer directly onto the battlefield from hand, bypassing its {8} equip cost (they'd still need to equip it later, but getting it onto the battlefield is important for Urza's Saga construct tokens and for future Stoneforge/equip lines). This is a free equipment cheat that the player declined for no good reason.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without activating Stoneforge Mystic, declining to put Colossus Hammer onto the battlefield.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Stoneforge Mystic by paying {1}{W} (using Urza's Saga for {C} and Sacred Foundry for {W}) to put Colossus Hammer from hand onto the battlefield. This grows future Construct tokens from Urza's Saga and sets up the hammer for equipping.

annotations.description: Chose to put Colossus Hammer onto the battlefield via Stoneforge Mystic's ability, but has no way to cheat its {8} equip cost (no Sigarda's Aid or Puresteel Paladin visible). The Hammer will sit uselessly on the battlefield. Meanwhile, putting the second Leyline Axe into play would allow equipping it for {3} (which the player can afford with available mana), giving Stoneforge Mystic +1/+1, double strike, and trample for immediate pressure against the opponent at 15 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Put Colossus Hammer onto the battlefield via Stoneforge Mystic, where it sits unequippable at {8} equip cost.
annotations.betterLine: Put Leyline Axe onto the battlefield, then equip it to Stoneforge Mystic for {3} to create a 2/3 double strike trample attacker immediately.

annotations.description: The player has an Arid Mesa in hand and a land drop available (they haven't played a land this turn). Playing Arid Mesa would give them access to additional mana next turn and also trigger Revolt for potential Fatal Push synergies in the future. Missing a land drop when you have a land in hand is almost always wrong, especially when Stoneforge Mystic needs mana to activate (putting equipment onto the battlefield costs 1W) and equipping Leyline Axe costs 3. The player needs mana to execute their game plan of getting Colossus Hammer or Leyline Axe equipped.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without playing the Arid Mesa from hand, missing a land drop.
annotations.betterLine: Play Arid Mesa before passing. This costs nothing and provides additional mana for future turns, which is critical for equipping Colossus Hammer (equip 8) or Leyline Axe (equip 3), or activating Stoneforge Mystic's ability to cheat equipment into play.

annotations.description: Cracking Arid Mesa to fetch a Sacred Foundry when they already have a Sacred Foundry in hand they could play as their land drop. This wastes 1 life (plus potentially 2 more for untapped) unnecessarily, and loses the fetch land which could be saved for later turns when revolt might matter or when they need to thin the deck at a better time.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Arid Mesa to fetch a Sacred Foundry from library
annotations.betterLine: Play the Sacred Foundry from hand as the land drop, preserving Arid Mesa for a future turn where revolt could be relevant or the extra land drop flexibility is needed.

annotations.description: Stoneforge Mystic has an activated ability ({1}{W}, {T}: Put an Equipment card from your hand onto the battlefield) that could put one of the two Leyline Axes from hand directly onto the battlefield. The player has Sacred Foundry (untapped) + Sunbaked Canyon (untapped) available to pay {1}{W}, and Stoneforge Mystic is untapped. Cheating a Leyline Axe into play would give the option to equip it to a creature (or have it ready), and more importantly it's a free equipment drop that increases Construct token size from Urza's Saga. Passing without using Stoneforge Mystic's ability wastes a key tempo advantage - especially since Stoneforge could tap to put Leyline Axe into play before combat, and the player could still play the Sacred Foundry from hand for other uses later.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Stoneforge Mystic's ability, leaving two Leyline Axes stranded in hand.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Stoneforge Mystic's ability (tap {1}{W} using Sunbaked Canyon + Sacred Foundry on battlefield) to put a Leyline Axe from hand onto the battlefield. This adds another artifact for Construct tokens and sets up future equips.

annotations.description: Passed priority in precombat main without playing Sacred Foundry from hand (missing a land drop) and without activating Stoneforge Mystic's ability ({1}{W}, {T}) to put a Leyline Axe from hand onto the battlefield. With Sacred Foundry + Plains + Sunbaked Canyon, they had the mana to activate Stoneforge Mystic and start setting up equipment. Missing both the land drop and the Stoneforge activation wastes significant tempo in a game where they need to assemble their equipment combo quickly against an opponent with Psychic Frog and Emperor of Bones threatening to take over.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without making any plays in precombat main phase.
annotations.betterLine: Play Sacred Foundry (untapped, paying 2 life), then activate Stoneforge Mystic ({1}{W}, {T}) to put Leyline Axe from hand onto the battlefield. This develops the board and sets up future equip turns to create a lethal threat.

annotations.description: Attacking with Stoneforge Mystic taps it, preventing use of its activated ability ({1}{W}, {T}) to put a Leyline Axe from hand onto the battlefield this turn. The attack risks the Mystic dying to a 2/2 Emperor of Bones block for at most 1 damage, while the Mystic's ability to cheat in equipment is far more valuable. With Colossus Hammer and Leyline Axe available, keeping Mystic untapped to put equipment into play is critical to the game plan.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with Stoneforge Mystic for 1 potential damage
annotations.betterLine: Keep Stoneforge Mystic back, use its {1}{W}, {T} ability (with Sacred Foundry + Sunbaked Canyon) to put Leyline Axe from hand onto the battlefield, setting up a massive equipped threat for subsequent turns.

annotations.description: Failed to discard excess lands to pump Psychic Frog before combat damage. ESPN had 3 lands in hand (Polluted Delta, Watery Grave, Swamp) with 2 lands already in play. Discarding 1-2 lands to Psychic Frog would deal extra damage while still drawing a card from the combat damage trigger, effectively converting excess lands into damage.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority during combat without pumping Psychic Frog, dealing only 1 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Discard 1-2 excess lands (e.g., Swamp and Watery Grave) to Psychic Frog to put +1/+1 counters on it, dealing 2-3 extra damage while still drawing a card from combat damage trigger.

annotations.description: Soul Spike can be cast for free by exiling two black cards from hand, dealing 4 damage and gaining 4 life. With two Soul Spikes and two Fatal Pushes in hand (all black cards), the player has the option to cast Soul Spike by exiling the other Soul Spike + a Fatal Push, providing a free 4-damage burst plus 4 life. Discarding a Soul Spike removes this powerful free-cast option. In a race situation against Hammer Time (which can threaten massive damage with Colossus Hammer + Leyline Axe), having access to a free 4-damage spell that also gains 4 life is extremely valuable. The player should have discarded a land instead (like Undercity Sewers which enters tapped, or one of the extra fetchlands/duals) since they already have two lands in play and multiple land drops in hand.
annotations.actionTaken: Discarded Soul Spike to hand size
annotations.betterLine: Discard Undercity Sewers (enters tapped, least impactful land) to preserve the possibility of free-casting Soul Spike by exiling two black cards (the other Soul Spike + Fatal Push) for 4 damage and 4 life gain

annotations.description: Missed lethal. Opponent's Psychic Frog and Emperor of Bones are both tapped, meaning no blockers. Player could use Stoneforge Mystic's ability to put Leyline Axe from hand onto the battlefield, then attack with Stoneforge Mystic and cast Battlefield Improvisation to attach Colossus Hammer + Leyline Axe (+ other equipment) to create a 15/16+ double strike trampler for 30+ unblockable damage against a 14hp opponent.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose to activate/equip Shadowspear instead of pursuing the lethal line.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Stoneforge Mystic ({1}{W}) to put Leyline Axe onto the battlefield, go to combat, attack with Stoneforge Mystic, cast Battlefield Improvisation ({1}{W}) targeting it to attach Colossus Hammer + Leyline Axe + other equipment for lethal double-strike trample damage.

annotations.description: Activating Shadowspear's '{1}: Permanents your opponents control lose hexproof and indestructible' ability when the opponent has no permanents with hexproof or indestructible (Psychic Frog and Emperor of Bones have neither). This wastes 1 mana for no effect. Additionally, they should be playing their Sacred Foundry from hand first to maximize available mana, and should be using Stoneforge Mystic's activated ability to cheat in Leyline Axe from hand.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Shadowspear's ability to remove hexproof/indestructible from opponent's permanents (which have neither)
annotations.betterLine: Play Sacred Foundry from hand first, then use Stoneforge Mystic's {1}{W},{T} ability to put Leyline Axe from hand onto the battlefield for free, then equip creatures or develop the board further

annotations.description: Chose to equip Shadowspear pre-combat before playing Sacred Foundry from hand. Should play the land first to maximize available mana, then go to combat where Battlefield Improvisation can attach all equipment to an attacking Stoneforge Mystic for potentially lethal damage against a tapped-out board.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Shadowspear equip ability before playing land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play Sacred Foundry first, then go to combat, attack with Stoneforge Mystic, and cast Battlefield Improvisation to attach Colossus Hammer + Leyline Axe + Shadowspear for lethal double-strike trample damage against tapped blockers.

annotations.description: Missed lethal. With both opponent creatures tapped (no blockers), attacking Stoneforge Mystic and casting Battlefield Improvisation (1W available from Sacred Foundry + Sunbaked Canyon) would attach Colossus Hammer (+10/+10), Shadowspear (+1/+1, trample, lifelink), Leyline Axe (+1/+1, double strike, trample), and Paradise Mantle to the attacking Mystic. That makes it a 15/16 with double strike and trample, dealing 30 damage — more than enough to kill the opponent at 14 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with Stoneforge Mystic as a 1/2, dealing only 1 damage and not casting Battlefield Improvisation.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Stoneforge Mystic, then in combat cast Battlefield Improvisation targeting it, attaching all Equipment (Colossus Hammer, Shadowspear, Leyline Axe, Paradise Mantle) for lethal damage with double strike.

annotations.description: Soul Spike can be cast for free by exiling two black cards from hand, dealing 4 damage and gaining 4 life. With the opponent at 9 life, Soul Spike represents a significant chunk of damage that could help close out the game. The player has Soul Spike in the graveyard already, plus this one in hand, and multiple black cards that could fuel the alternate cost. Discarding it removes a potential 4-damage burst that could be critical for finishing the opponent. While the mana cost of 7 is prohibitive, the alternate cost of exiling two black cards from hand is very achievable - the player has Fatal Push x2 and could draw more black cards. At 9 life, the opponent is in Soul Spike range if combined with Psychic Frog attacks.
annotations.actionTaken: Discarded Soul Spike to Psychic Frog's end-of-turn cleanup/discard trigger
annotations.betterLine: Discard a Swamp or Undercity Sewers instead. The player already has 5 lands on the battlefield and 4 more land cards in hand - they have far more lands than needed. Keeping Soul Spike preserves the option to deal 4 damage for free by exiling two black cards (like the two Fatal Pushes if removal isn't needed), which could represent lethal alongside Psychic Frog attacks against an opponent at 9 life.

annotations.description: Missed lethal. With both opponent creatures tapped and opponent at 11 life, casting Puresteel Paladin would activate Metalcraft (4 artifacts on board), allowing free equip of Colossus Hammer, Shadowspear, and Leyline Axe to Stoneforge Mystic for a massive double-striking, trampling, lifelinking attack that deals well over 11 damage unblocked.
annotations.actionTaken: Attempted to use Stoneforge Mystic's activated ability instead of recognizing the lethal line through Puresteel Paladin.
annotations.betterLine: Play Sacred Foundry (untapped), cast Puresteel Paladin (WW), achieve Metalcraft, equip Colossus Hammer + Shadowspear + Leyline Axe to Stoneforge Mystic for free, attack for lethal with double strike and trample.

annotations.description: Paid 2 life on Sacred Foundry to enter untapped (going from 8 to 6 life) against an aggressive board with Psychic Frog and Emperor of Bones. The player's reasoning was based on a hallucinated Puresteel Paladin on the battlefield, believing they could equip Colossus Hammer for free. Without Puresteel Paladin, the extra untapped mana is less critical, and preserving life at 8 rather than 6 would provide more buffer against the opponent's threats.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Sacred Foundry untapped, paying 2 life to go from 8 to 6 life.
annotations.betterLine: Play Sacred Foundry tapped to stay at 8 life, since without Puresteel Paladin the extra mana this turn is less likely to enable a game-winning play, and staying at higher life is important against the opponent's aggressive creatures.

annotations.description: Playing Undercity Sewers (enters tapped) instead of Polluted Delta or Swamp delays casting Sheoldred, the Apocalypse by a full turn. With the opponent at 6 life, Sheoldred is devastating - it's a 4/5 deathtouch that drains the opponent whenever they draw. Additionally, cracking Polluted Delta would enable Revolt for Fatal Push to kill up to MV 4 creatures like Stoneforge Mystic.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Undercity Sewers, which enters tapped, leaving only 3 available mana this turn and delaying Sheoldred.
annotations.betterLine: Play Polluted Delta, crack it for a Swamp (enabling Revolt for Fatal Push), then cast Sheoldred, the Apocalypse with 4 mana (BBUB). This puts immediate lethal pressure on the 6-life opponent and stabilizes ESPN's life total.

annotations.description: Battlefield Improvisation provides lethal damage this turn. Stoneforge Mystic is attacking into no blockers. Casting Battlefield Improvisation (1W, payable with Plains + Sacred Foundry) gives +2/+2 and attaches all Equipment: Colossus Hammer (+10/+10), Shadowspear (+1/+1, trample, lifelink), Leyline Axe (+1/+1, double strike, trample), Paradise Mantle. That's 15 power with double strike and trample = 30 damage against 11 life. This is lethal.
annotations.actionTaken: Failed to recognize and execute the lethal line with Battlefield Improvisation during combat
annotations.betterLine: Cast Battlefield Improvisation targeting the attacking Stoneforge Mystic to attach all Equipment and deal lethal damage with double strike
